coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 6 ground-truth variable items (50%): the gradient-method comparison, computation-time measurement, and numerical-stability assessment through gradient comparisons. Timing includes forward/backward computation and separate backward timing.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses SGD rather than fixed Adam settings and varies batch size instead of holding it constant. Restricts hardware to CPU rather than varying CPU, GPU, and distributed multi-GPU. Replaces ResNet18/ResNet50 model-scale comparisons with one small LSTM. Stability measurements omit loss evolution and gradient-norm tracking, although gradient-error comparisons provide a relevant stability measure. The placeholder TorchOpt API and PyTorch fallback also risk testing a different method.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the expected conclusion that TorchOpt's design should reduce computation and enhance numerical stability, verifiable through computation-time and memory-use comparisons against traditional back-propagation.
